content: Build four Go archives, checksums.txt, the OpenClaw package, the Hermes package, and the Hermes SHA-256 sidecar from one protected source revision.
Generate one sorted release-manifest.sha256 covering exactly the eight release payload files.
Verify every manifest record and reject missing, extra-class, renamed, or modified payload input.
Keep the ordinary test job at contents-read only and place id-token write permission only on a separate post-test signing job.
Allow keyless signing only for same-repository pull requests and protected repository pushes; do not sign untrusted fork pull-request payloads.
Sign the exact release manifest with GitHub OIDC keyless identity and write one Sigstore bundle without storing a long-lived private key.
Verify the bundle using the exact GitHub workflow identity and token.actions.githubusercontent.com issuer.
Modify one manifest byte and require signature verification to fail.
Verify the unchanged manifest against a wrong workflow identity and require rejection.
Confirm the signed synthetic merge is GitHub-verified and its second parent equals the exact source head.
Stream the signed artifact through the existing Qingdao reverse-management tunnel and independently verify payload hashes, bundle identity, issuer, and source revision.
Record the protected run, artifact, manifest, bundle, certificate identity, transparency proof, negative controls, and explicit non-claims without credentials or OIDC tokens.
